title: WPMS/1140/2024 of KAVITA VERMA Vs DIRECTOR SWAJAL PROJECT

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1140 of 2024
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
(1) Mr. Anand Kumar Pandey, learned
counsel for the petitioner.
(2) Mr. K.K. Shah, learned Additional
C.S.C. for the State of Uttarakhand.
(3) By m eans of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following
substantive reliefs: -
(i) I ssue a writ, order or direction, in the
nature of mandamus commanding and
directing the respondent no. 2 to remove
the illegally constructed public toilet
situated in front of the field of the brother
of petitioner.
(ii) I ssue a writ, order or direction, in the
nature of mandamus commanding and
directing the respondent no. 2 to decide the
representation dated 12.06.2023, which is
still pending before the respondent no. 2.
(4) I n sum and substance, case of the
petitioner is that her grandfather had
donated a piece of land for construction
of road, however, respondents
authorities, after constructing road, have
also constructed a public toilet in front of
land of the petitioner, which is not only
creating nuisance for the petitioner and
other persons residing in the locality, but
it has also resulted in diminution of the
value of land.
(5) Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that petitioner is not able to use

the land adjacent to the road for any
purpose, therefore, she has sought a
direction to the Com missioner for
rem oval of illegally constructed public
toilet.
(6) Learned State Counsel was asked to
get instruction in the m atter. Mr. K.K.
Shah, learned Additional C.S.C., on
instructions, subm its that the toilet was
constructed under SWAJAL PROJECT and
petitioner did not raise any objection
while the toilet was being constructed.
He, however, submits that if petitioner
m akes a representation, highlighting her
grievance, the sam e shall be considered
sym pathetically.
(7) Accordingly, writ petition is
disposed of with liberty to petitioner to
m ake representation to respondent no. 3
for relocating the public toilet to som e
other place. I f petitioner m akes such
representation within two weeks from
today, respondent no. 3 shall take
decision thereupon sym pathetically,
within six weeks thereafter.

( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 15.05.2024
Aswal
